cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery between May 2009 and April 2010 in Burkina Faso
finding: The proportion of births by cesarean delivery in Burkina Faso was 1.5%, with significant regional variation, and cesarean deliveries were primarily performed for absolute maternal indications.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries for non-absolute maternal indications were more common in private hospitals, among women in urban areas, during scheduled cesareans, and when a partogram was not used.
